title: MADE MEN
question: Are SQ-03F hotspot edges concentrated into a smaller set of source neurons than expected after preserving edge-level context opportunity and structural strata?

hotspot_sets.S: reuse exact SQ-03F top-1-percent membership by max integrated S
hotspot_sets.C: reuse exact SQ-03F top-1-percent membership by max integrated C

universe.source_identity: pre neuron label from the conservative matched graph
universe.context_signature: ordered pair (input, anchor) from SQ-03D/SQ-03B membership

primary_observed_metrics: fraction of hotspot edges whose source has >=2 hotspot edges
maximum hotspot-edge count for any one source
HHI of hotspot-edge counts across hotspot-producing sources
secondary_observed_metrics: median hotspot-edge count per hotspot-producing source
top-1 source share of hotspot edges
top-5 source share of hotspot edges
number of sources represented in >=2 distinct input-anchor context signatures
maximum distinct input-anchor context signatures for any source
opportunity_audit: sum of candidate-edge context_count per source
distinct candidate input-anchor context signatures per source

null_model.name: STRATIFIED HOTSPOT-LABEL RANDOMIZATION
null_model.mechanics: For S and C independently, preserve the exact observed hotspot count within every stratum. Within each stratum, randomly assign the hotspot labels to candidate edges without replacement. Source identities and edge context memberships remain fixed.
null_model.purpose: Preserves the number of hotspot opportunities in the same context-count and structural strata while asking whether observed hotspot labels cluster into sources more than the stratified edge universe alone would produce.

randomization_reporting.interpretation: Null percentile rank is a descriptive randomization reference inside one frozen model, not a biological population probability.

frozen_interpretation: Fewer unique hotspot sources, a larger repeated-source edge fraction, or greater source-count HHI than the stratified null is compatible with hotspot recurrence being concentrated into particular sources beyond edge opportunity alone.
Agreement with the stratified null is compatible with the repeated-source pattern being explained by source opportunity and the frozen edge-level strata.
Distinct input-anchor recurrence is descriptive evidence of cross-context reuse inside the model; it does not establish a biological neuron class or general cross-condition mechanism.

family_model.translation: Do the same capos keep showing up in different jobs, or do large crews merely get more chances to appear in the books?
family_model.firewall: Family Model language is presentation-only and downstream of evidence.

claim_boundary: SQ-03F.3 may describe source-level recurrence and concentration of frozen model hotspot edges relative to a stratified randomization reference. It does not establish biological cell classes, sex mechanisms, organism behavior, population statistics, or financial utility.
